metadata.title: sivak.ai — AI agents for computer work
metadata.description: We build AI agents that handle the work people do at a computer. They take over 80% of the routine, so your team can focus on the 20% that drives results.

hero.title: Let AI agents do
hero.lead: We build agents around your processes. They handle the work people do at a computer today — from invoices and customer support to software testing.

gain.title: of your time for what really matters
gain.text: Agents take over 80% of the routine computer work. Spend the freed-up time on customers, your team and growing the business.

ratio.title: Routine first. That's where AI pays off fastest.
ratio.text: Routine computer work fills most of the working day and delivers the least: retyping data, checks, looking things up, the same answers over and over. That's what agents take over first. Your people keep the 20% of work that brings 80% of the results.

services.title: We build, deploy and run your agents
services.lead: We don't sell a generic chatbot. We build solutions for specific work in your company and keep looking after them after launch.

items.title: AI agents on your team
items.text: Digital colleagues for specific jobs. They handle requests, check documents and test software. The agent prepares, a person decides.

items.title: AI on top of your data
items.text: We connect AI to your ERP, CRM and spreadsheets. Ask in plain language and get answers backed by numbers.

items.title: Process automation
items.text: We connect systems that don't talk to each other. Data moves on its own, with no retyping from one window to another.

items.title: Robots for legacy software
items.text: They operate programs with no API — Helios, DOS applications and in-house systems no one wants to rewrite.

useCases.title: An agent can do the work you do at a computer today
useCases.lead: It works in applications just like a person. It reads emails and documents, fills in forms, clicks through systems and hands the finished work over for review.

items.text: Sorts email, summarizes important threads and prepares a summary from ERP and CRM every morning.
Schedules jobs from incoming orders, keeps an eye on materials in stock and drafts purchase requests.
Pulls campaign data, compares it with targets and prepares client reports.
Investigates the request, looks up the customer's history and drafts a reply.
Extracts incoming invoices, checks them and matches them with orders and payments.
Updates contacts in the CRM, prepares quote materials and tracks who needs a follow-up.
Compares supplier quotes and keeps an eye on stock levels and delivery dates.
Tests a new app release in a browser and backs up the result with a video.

useCases.more: Don't see your work here? If it's done at a computer, an agent can most likely do it.

process.title: From the first meeting to an agent at work
process.lead: We start with a small step and a clear result, and expand once the agent has proven itself.

steps.title: Intro meeting
steps.text: We go through your processes and find the routine that takes up the most time.

steps.title: ROI estimate
steps.text: We calculate how many hours the agent will save and when the investment pays back. You know before we start.

steps.title: Pilot agent
steps.text: We build an agent for one process. Your people review its work while we measure the results.

steps.title: Operation and growth
steps.text: We run, monitor and improve the agent. Once it proves itself, it takes on more work.

deployment.title: In the cloud or on your own hardware
deployment.lead: You decide where your agents run. If data must not leave the company, we deploy them on your own server with local AI models, which work even with no internet access at all.

options.title: Cloud solutions
options.text: Agents use the most capable AI models in the cloud. You need no hardware of your own, so you start sooner.
options.fit: For a fast start and top performance.

options.title: On your own hardware
options.text: Agents and AI models run on a server in your company. Data never leaves your network, and everything works without internet access.
options.fit: For sensitive data, manufacturing and closed networks.

control.title: The agent prepares. A person decides.
control.lead: Agents work within clear limits. You always know what they do, what they can access and how they reached a result.

items.title: A person approves
items.text: Important steps, such as replying to a customer, posting an entry or placing an order, are always confirmed by a person.

items.title: Only the access it needs
items.text: An agent gets access only to what its job requires. Usually read-only.

items.title: No passwords
items.text: Credentials are managed by the system. The agent never gets its hands on them.

items.title: Trials on a copy
items.text: It tests and tries things out on a copy of your data. Live operations stay untouched.

items.title: Every step recorded
items.text: Every action is logged, including screenshots and video. You know what the agent did and why.

items.title: Measurable results
items.text: You see how much work the agent has done and how much time it has saved you.

case.title: A team of AI agents for a software company
case.lead: For a software company, we run agents that work every day alongside the people in support, testing and development.

agents.name: Customer support
agents.text: Investigates every new request. Reads the customer's history, checks the data in the app and drafts a reply. A person sends it.
agents.meta: checks for new requests every 10 minutes

agents.name: Testing
agents.text: Tries each new release in a real browser, the way a tester would. Backs up the result with screenshots and video.

agents.name: Development and code review
agents.text: Prepares code changes from the spec, and an independent agent reviews them. A person approves and deploys.

agents.name: Studio for colleagues
agents.text: Colleagues who don't code describe an idea and see it in the app right away. They hand developers a finished proposal.
agents.meta: from idea to proposal, no coding

items.q: Do we need to change our systems?
items.a: No. The agent works in the applications you already use. Where there's no integration, it operates the program through the screen, just like a person.

items.q: What if the agent makes a mistake?
items.a: The agent prepares, a person decides. Important steps are always approved by a person, and every action is recorded, so you know what the agent did and why.

items.q: How soon will we see results?
items.a: We start with the process where an agent pays off fastest. From the first day of operation, we measure how much work it does and how much time it saves.
The agent only gets access to what its job requires, usually read-only. It never sees passwords and tries things out on a copy of your data, not in live operations.

items.q: Does the agent have to run in the cloud?
items.a: No. We build agents in the cloud and on your own hardware with local models that work without internet access. Your data then never leaves the company.

items.q: What kinds of companies do you work with?
items.a: Companies where people spend a lot of time on routine computer work: manufacturing, trade, services and marketing agencies. The industry doesn't matter; what matters is how much time the routine takes.
